subject: No longer working under MacOS Sierra

messages.author: 2b2fefdc6d9ddeec
messages.subject: No longer working under MacOS Sierra
parts:
Hi, I recently started to have a few problems with the windowing environment on a MacBook Pro, running Sierra.  (I am sorry, I seem to have lost the log file that had the error messages I was recieiving.)  I am using mplus automation via R-Studio.  Now the line,

createModels("~/Dropbox/EvanEric/LOSEM/LTS.Age7.quad_FSIQ.standardizedSESLOSEM.inp")

hangs RStudio without a response, I have to force quit and restart it.

I know that isn't much information, but does it sound like anything familiar?

Eric

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] No longer working under MacOS Sierra
parts:
Hi Eric,

Sounds new to me.  One thing that I have seen occasionally with things like Dropbox, Google Drive, etc. is that if they are trying to sync, they can temporarily lock files to changes and this has caused me difficulty before.  Two things I think you could try are:

(1) see if its any different when running outside of dropbox
(2) start R directly (i.e., outside of RStudio) and see what happens to try to isolate if its something to do with the interaction with RStudio or not

Best,

Josh
